Grafts the DOCUMENT tree into the given PANE node via RAII Attachment.

detaileddescription.para: The Attachment is owned by this Component and ungrafts automatically on destruction. Panes::closeWhelmed() needs only to destroy the Component — no manual removeChild.

paneNode
The PANE juce::ValueTree node to graft into. Must be valid.
MESSAGE THREAD. Called by Panes::createWhelmed after component creation.
Destroying this Component destroys documentAttachment, which ungrafts the tree. If the PANE node was already removed from the tree by paneManager::remove(), Attachment::~Attachment performs a safe no-op (node.getParent().isValid() check).
